Status.note: Status is unchanged. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 55101, generator 0001, 77.4 MW, operating since June 1999, with no planned retirement. A renewal application for the plant's operating permit was filed in May 2026, which also points to continued operation. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale announced.
